owner_intent: Build Mechanicus toward 100% closure across six organ gates without fake-green.
Mechanicus is code/script-first and must not depend on internal LLM magic for Core v1.
A future local model membrane is recorded only as a deferred after-Core-v1 capability, not a current dependency.

may_do: define and validate script-first technical gates
separate proven, partial, future, forbidden and rejected capabilities
advise future task/tool routing only through measured evidence
may_not_do: claim MECHANICUS_ASSEMBLED before all six gates have external proof
treat tool inventory as tool trust
grant real execution authority without future safe-execution gate and Owner approval
use a local model membrane as validator, land authority or shell authority
bypass WARP, Custodes, Throne or Owner review

six_gates.title: Identity / Manifest Gate
six_gates.target_state: organ identity, boundaries, forbidden claims and manifest are machine-readable

six_gates.title: Functions Gate
six_gates.target_state: functions are enumerated with status and evidence requirements

six_gates.title: Capability Evidence Gate
six_gates.target_state: declared functions bind to reports, receipts and validators

six_gates.title: Personal Validators Gate
six_gates.target_state: Mechanicus has validators proving its own identity, functions, evidence and claim discipline

six_gates.title: Current Truth / Receipts Gate
six_gates.target_state: current reports/receipts distinguish current truth from history and debt

six_gates.title: Residency / Trust Gate
six_gates.target_state: quarantine, negative examples, host-bound proof and external audits are classified and prosecuted

local_model_membrane.allowed_future_role: intent translation and capability explanation only
